implementation: Cloud directly: coupled artifact, progress and frontend reporting; no local delegation.
finding: The recorded no-candidate outcome is correct. Two completed trials had 0/5 and 2/5 positive folds against a 3/5 requirement, with 24 and 30 filled orders. The UI hid the reason, described completed rejected trials as absent, and exposed a rejection sentinel as a score.
changes: Shared diagnostics distinguish completed, qualifying, pruned and failed trials; describe positive-fold requirements, activity and missing/nonfinite evidence.
New artifacts and terminal progress retain diagnostics. Older saved runs and progress reconstruct them from recorded development evidence without rewriting artifacts.
Saved and job views expose counts and accessible rejection details. Charts exclude rejection sentinels and incomplete trial values; the candidate reading says Not qualifying.
Optional evidence arguments are passed only when capture is enabled, preserving non-capture evaluator compatibility.
The existing launcher build/cleanup regression explicitly selects static mode, matching its asserted behavior.

checks.impeccable_detector: No findings on changed UI targets
checks.visual_review: Desktop 1440px and mobile 390px screenshots inspected; rejection details use a keyboard-focusable scrolling region and preserve document width.
checks.saved_evidence: Actual QQQ artifact hash unchanged after read-only API/research diagnostics reconstruction; saved parameters empty and outer holdout UNTOUCHED.

initial_check_failures: Two new browser assertions matched both chart text and its screen-reader description; selectors were scoped to the chart.
The first full Python invocation used a relative PYTHONPATH that failed in two subprocess tests. Final verification used the absolute runtime package path.
Full Python checks exposed the optional-capture compatibility issue and an existing static-launcher test relying on a former default; both corrected before final verification.
limits: Browser workflow tests use isolated API fixtures. Live dashboard health and served saved-run/progress diagnostics are checked separately after restart.
No new observed-market optimization campaign was launched. Adding development trials cannot guarantee a qualifier.
Qualification, risk limits, existing parameters and consumed-holdout locks are unchanged.
